prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: loose homepage sketch to isolate afterward
Input images: Image 1 supplies only the shelf-and-plant motif and approximate placement; Image 2 is the approved window drawing and is the sole authority for looseness, sparse density, weak line quality, and messy annotation style
Primary request: redraw the shelf and plant much less cleanly, as a tiny uncertain notebook scribble—not an illustration
Subject: retain only a crooked shelf, two rough brackets, a small lopsided pot, and three hesitant plant marks
Style/medium: match Image 2 closely; faint graphite and weak ballpoint, broken contours, false starts, doubled and abandoned marks, visibly unskilled but observant
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3; object only in the middle third; at least two thirds of canvas visually empty
Annotations: replace every readable word with three tiny clusters of barely decipherable private shorthand—overlapping letters, scratched-out fragments, inconsistent scale and baseline; they should feel like notes never intended for another person to read; add two weak crooked arrows
Background: completely flat pure white, opaque, featureless; no transparency checkerboard and no texture
Constraints: under twenty-five principal strokes; no shading, no leaf detail, no clean straight edges
Avoid: legible sentences, neat handwriting, font-like letters, calligraphy, confident illustration, accurate geometry, clean perspective, paper grain, checkerboard, gray background, shadow, border, watermark

Post-processing: the flat generated background was converted to real alpha transparency; generated linework, notes, and composition otherwise preserved.
